correction.corrected_test: Goal is exactly the post-macro tree state. One action is evaluated. No primitive action reaches that goal in one step.
correction.problem_in_previous_position_test: After a correct nested macro, the old goal still required a second primitive cleanup in an unseen orientation (e.g. 1*x -> x), conflating macro position invariance with primitive generalization.

interpretation.important_detail: The corrected test removes the earlier primitive-cleanup confound; success now means the intended structural macro was selected and applied at the unseen tree position.
interpretation.statement: Verified G1-G3-derived non-root curriculum increased direct nested-macro application from 2/16 to 5/16 on the corrected one-step position test. The paired four-seed Hoeffding lower bound remains below zero, so this is a glimpse, not a certified neural abstraction result.

protocol.root_only: Original 12 root macro examples + 12 primitive intermediate examples.
protocol.rsi_direct_matched: Same 12 primitive examples; replace the 12 root macro examples with 12 non-root examples generated from verified G1/G2/G3 contexts: one per macro per generation. Each target is the exact one-step post-macro state.
